source_text.body:
Create lesson plans and slides with speaker notes for teachers
A teacher uses Google AI Studio and Gemini to create lesson plans and presentation slides with speaker notes, and also uses Claude in the same workflow.
·
Oct 1, 2025
Done with
GE
Gemini
CL
Claude
What they did
The poster’s workflow starts by uploading topic photos to Google AI Studio and having Gemini 2.5 Pro generate lesson plans, slide templates, and speaker notes. They keep a large shared context for a whole quarter so Gemini can also make exams, quizzes, and personalized feedback, then bring Claude into math lessons when they want a more challenging lesson flow because Gemini tends to oversimplify.
How it went
They say Gemini can handle a full quarter’s worth of materials in one context and one-shot many requests. The stated weak spots are math difficulty tuning and Claude’s usage limits, which keep them from experimenting enough with prompts.
Worth knowing
The main catch is Claude’s limits; the poster says that is why they were considering upgrading.
Try it yourself
with
Gemini
Copy prompt
Create a lesson plan for [grade level] [subject] on [topic], lasting [minutes] minutes, aligned to [standard or curriculum]. Include objectives, activities, and a quick check for understanding. Then build a slide deck outline of about [number] slides, with speaker notes for each slide that I can read aloud. Finish when I have both the plan and the full slide text with notes.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1oj60c3/how_do_you_use_claude_for_making_educational
